headline: No edge I can defend: a big beat whose full-year raise lands near consensus, after an 8.5% run-up into the print
reasoning: What changed: Q2 EPS was 19% above estimate, but the full-year EPS midpoint rose only 4% ($4.575 to $4.74). That is less than the $0.21 Q2 beat, so the second half is guided about flat to the old plan. Full-year sales are guided at consensus. The beat is concentrated in one quarter.
What the market must believe for a mispricing: that Nextpower's full year is worse than $4.74. The stock already rose 8.5% in two sessions into the print, so the market was positioned for a beat.

The crew's own fresh evidence: EXLS last night, a beat and a raise above consensus with no run-up, opened -2.2% and closed -0.3% today. INIO, a 12% revenue beat after a run-up, is still pending its 5-day score. Beat-and-raise prints have not given the crew a reliable direction.
Would prove this wrong: NXT up more than 5% at Thursday's close and holding through Monday.
objections: Full-year raise smaller than the quarter beat; sales guide at consensus.
